errors.quote: Since $T_0,S_0$ are bijections agreeing off $\mathcal B$, $T_0S_0^{-1}$ fixes $\mathcal B^c$ and permutes $\mathcal B$.
errors.problem: The inference does not follow from the stated premises. Agreement off B only gives T_0S_0^{-1}=id on S_0(B^c)=T_0(B^c). The paper first notes that T_0 preserves all guard values and hence B, so T_0(B^c)=B^c and S_0(B)=B.

errors.quote: Slot width is $L=(e/m)K$, so change of basis and inverse cost $O(V((eK)^\tau+1))$
errors.problem: This is stated unconditionally. The paper's bound holds under the lemma's asymptotic hypotheses (otherwise the MA^3 and delta_bad MA(R+A) terms remain). It requires a fixed order m>=3 (so a third slot z exists) and a decomposition into a fixed number of row additions.
The paper defines A_rect=ceil(log2(2V)) only as a length bound. Record addresses have ceil(log2 M)<=A_rect bits (the rank keys are padded to that), so A is not the address length.
